raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "send"
  role subject "the notary from Câmpina"
  role object "the intabulation file"
  role destination "OCPI Prahova"
  role time "9 September"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?who
  where match
    relation "pick up"
    role subject ?who
    role object "the intabulation deed"
    role source "OCPI Prahova"
    polarity affirmed
  end
